# Support Questions

The Laravel support guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#support-questions).

For questions about Laravel Cloud itself — as opposed to this Terraform
provider — see the [Laravel Cloud documentation](https://cloud.laravel.com/docs)
or contact Laravel Cloud support.

Please open an issue here only for bugs in the provider, or for provider
features you would like to see.
